Name: FS - Alternative Hair Pack
Author: FaerieFangs0
Description:
[center] [/center][center]﻿﻿ ﻿I needed to think of a way to get some of my goth friends to play Stardew with me, as well as wishing my own hair was in the game, so I made this pack. We get fun witchy packs of clothes, and cottage core stuff, but not so many alt pieces. If my mods are my children, I am an absent father, so if I get more ideas for this, I'll add them in the future when I get smacked with the ADHD hyperfocus stick. Hopefully a few people outside of my immediate friend group also like this mod.


- ﻿This pack consists of 2 styles inspired by goth bat's nest hair, as well as a sort of mohawk/death hawk style.

﻿- The bang styles include straight, V, and shaved sides that compliment the mohawk, but they can all be combined with the above hairs. They're an accessory, and can be colored separately for a split or duo-toned hair look. 

Forgot to test this with the male sprite, but it should work fine(?) If there are any gaps or weird things going on, let me know.

These might clip with certain hats, or be too poofy. They're based on big hairstyles, after all.

﻿I strongly would recommend the [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Alt-Fashion Set[/url] and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15417]Cottage Core Set[/url]﻿ with this mod if you don't have them already!

﻿This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969?tab=files]Fashion Sense[/url] and its dependencies. ﻿﻿[/center]
